purpose: Research competitor structures and current Apple, Google and Japanese release constraints, then convert supported findings into Cat's Tower-specific adoption rules and a preseal release-gate registry.

sourceClasses.OFFICIAL_DEVELOPER: developer or publisher first-party site, announcement or help
sourceClasses.STORE_LISTING: Apple App Store or Google Play listing and version history
sourceClasses.JAPAN_PRIMARY: Japanese regulator, ministry, authority or statutory guidance
sourceClasses.INDUSTRY_ANALYSIS: named third-party market or design analysis; contextual only
sourceClasses.USER_REVIEW: store/community review; dissatisfaction hypothesis, not verified fact
sourceClasses.INFERENCE: Cat's Tower interpretation derived from cited evidence; explicitly labeled

acceptance.requirement: Every material finding has source class, publisher, title, observed date, publication or update date when available, and URL.
Official/store/platform/regulator facts are never merged with user-review or inference claims.
All six competitors are covered, and unsupported pity, rate, price or reset details are marked NOT_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED rather than guessed.
All comparison dimensions receive supported findings or an explicit evidence gap.
Adoption, rejection and transformation decisions preserve Cat's Tower product boundary and do not copy protected expression or exact live-service values.
Apple and Google release gates use current first-party policy or documentation.
Japanese card-matching, prepaid-payment, privacy and minor-protection considerations use primary public sources where available.
Legal conclusions are not asserted; expert review and submission-time policy refresh are explicit gates.
POLICY_RELEASE_GATES.json is PRESEAL_DRAFT, machine-readable, testable and cannot authorize Step 2.
No runtime, asset, V1 executable, backend, provider, PR or Production operation occurs.
Route-specific independent critic and checkpoint judge leave unresolved P0/P1 at zero before PASS.
Exact content/evidence commits, trees, paths and matching kimi Preview deployments are recorded.

failureConditions: review anecdotes presented as verified game mechanics
unsupported exact probability, price, reward or pity copied from competitors
raw competitor UI, naming, image, animation or formula treated as a production specification
legal advice or guaranteed store approval claimed
